organizational.highlight: This is the last recurring FCR breakout call; future calls will be ad hoc as needed

client_updates.highlight: Grandine: PR ready, 3 failing tests due to known spec issue; awaiting fixed test vectors
Lodestar: FCR implementation working on mainnet; a few spec tests disabled in CI pending updated vectors
Prysm: FCR branch passing latest nightly spec tests; not yet run on mainnet or devnet; deeper review still needed
Teku: Merging FCR feature branch to master in smaller chunks; ~2–3 weeks remaining; investigating Lighthouse comparison failure

testing_progress.highlight: Glamsterdam devnet FCR report published by EthPandaOps; waiting on Prysm and Teku for full client comparison run
Client comparison on historical data via FCR simulator deferred until Prysm and Teku are production-ready
Several consensus-specs PRs merged (#5449, #5489, #5498, #5499): fix safe execution block hash bug and disabled-BLS test issues

fcr_safe_block_hash.highlight: Proposal: set safeBlockHash to finalizedBlockHash (not justified) when FCR is disabled; safety of justified is questionable
Potuz: Arbitrum was using SAFE for deposits; likely runs own nodes so probably unaffected by this change
Only Nimbus enables FCR by default; all other clients use a feature flag, so operators opting in understand the implications

fcr_node_restart_behavior.highlight: On CL restart, safeBlockHash may reset to finalized; behavior is implementation-dependent (Lighthouse persists fork choice to disk; Prysm does not)
Consensus: caching the confirmed root across restarts is safe provided it is not older than 2 epochs; EL could perform this fallback itself

fcr_post_gloas.highlight: Post-Gloas: FCR confirms payload from 2 slots ago due to new slot structure; using PTC votes to recover the previous slot's payload is under consideration but deemed complex and risky
Decoupled Consensus will ship its own confirmation rule, likely deprecating current FCR; improvement work may not be warranted given this roadmap

action_items.action: Post thoughts on fuzzing FCR implementations to the Telegram group; contact Nikos (EF security team) re: agent-swarm review
Once Prysm and Teku FCR implementations are production-ready, ask EthPandaOps to re-run cross-client historical comparison simulations

decisions.decision: FCR recurring breakout call series concluded; future coordination via ad hoc calls and Telegram
No change made to safeBlockHash fallback behavior (FCR disabled → justified); deferred pending clarity on who relies on justified block hash
PTC-based improvement to FCR for post-Gloas slot structure not pursued now; decoupled Consensus will supersede current FCR
